verdict.rationale: Moss has a public GitHub repository (usemoss/moss) that describes its retrieval features and WASM build, and it hosts the official CLI package source under packages/moss-cli, so some product source is readable. Nothing in the evidence names an open-source license, and it is unclear whether the core runtime, rather than just SDKs and CLI, is published. missing for 10: evidence of an explicit OSI/open license, confirmation that the core search runtime source is public, independent corroboration.
